newsitem.title: USA: LodgeNet agrees to offer services in Peru.
newsitem.headline: LodgeNet agrees to offer services in Peru.

text.p: LodgeNet Entertainment Corp on Tuesday said it reached an agreement with Ditel SA to offer LodgeNet interactive television services in Peruvian hotels.
Ditel, an international licensee, has begun to outfit Peruvian hotels with the LodgeNet systems, which deliver on-demand movies, Super Nintendo Entertainment System video games and other services.
Lodgenet provides video on demand, network-based video games, cable programming, and other interactive multimedia entertainment and information services to hotels.
Ditel installs and maintains telecommunication equipment and computer systems.
